text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, phenytoin sodium 100 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory across our three sites ranges from 13.2 to 30.6 days on hand. The lowest stock is at Corvale Lakeside with 13.2 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows phenytoin sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Our product label identifies A-S Medication Solutions as the labeler and plant performing relabel and repack operations. FDA inspected that plant on 2026-08-12 and classified the inspection VAI. The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05. Earlier FDA inspections in 2009, 2012, 2013, and 2018 were also classified VAI.

Our position: Supply is adequate at two sites but thin at Corvale Lakeside. No national shortage is declared. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list, though their labels do not identify plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC to replenish Corvale Lakeside stock; P&T Committee to approve addition of Amneal as a sourced supplier.
2. Buyer to evaluate Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvPAK, Major Pharmaceuticals, and Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary sources; P&T Committee to approve any selected alternates.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and A-S Medication Solutions inspection outcomes monthly; Pharmacy Director to approve continued surveillance plan.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
